/kind feature

#### What this PR does / why we need it:
Bump cel-go to v0.23.2.

#### Which issue(s) this PR fixes:
<!--
*Automatically closes linked issue when PR is merged.
Usage: `Fixes #<issue number>`, or `Fixes (paste link of issue)`.
_If PR is about `failing-tests or flakes`, please post the related issues/tests in a comment and do not use `Fixes`_*
-->
Fixes #129869 

#### Special notes for your reviewer:

The changes we wanna get into k8s from this version bump:
- Cost tracking for two-variable comprehensions and bindings [https://github.com/google/cel-go/pull/1104]
- Fix two-variable comprehension pruning [https://github.com/google/cel-go/pull/1083]
- Introduce versioning options to all extensions [https://github.com/google/cel-go/pull/1075]
- Minor release to address cost tracking and size estimation [https://github.com/google/cel-go/pull/1113]
- Minor update on cost order in https://github.com/google/cel-go/pull/1119

This change would affect the estimated cost of optional map by adding estimated cost 1(see the added test cases. Thanks @TristonianJones for the fix and help on risk evaluation! :) ).
It is a bug fix and would affect the estimated cost of optional map only. We consider the risk is small and would like to merge it as it is.


#### Does this PR introduce a user-facing change?

issue_context.title: apiserver incompatible with cel-go 0.23.0
issue_context.body:
I hit this error when a robot updated google/cel-go to 0.23.0 in a project that vendors k8s.io/apiserver v0.32.1:
```
# k8s.io/apiserver/pkg/cel/environment
vendor/k8s.io/apiserver/pkg/cel/environment/base.go:176:19: cannot use ext.TwoVarComprehensions (value of type func(options ...ext.TwoVarComprehensionsOption) "github.com/google/cel-go/cel".EnvOption) as func() "github.com/google/cel-go/cel".EnvOption value in argument to UnversionedLib
```
https://github.com/cilium/tetragon/pull/3290

I traced the problem, and it seems the incompatibility was introduced by https://github.com/google/cel-go/pull/1075/ that changed the type of `TwoVarComprehensions` (from `func() cel.EnvOption` to `func(...TwoVarComprehensionsOption) cel.EnvOption`).

ah just found this PR that bumps cel-go and fixes apiserver: https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/129844/

IMHO: You should probably not bump cel-go and stick to whatever default is implied by importing apiserver, we are very careful with the upgrades.

cc @cici37 @jpbetz who may have a different, better informed view :-)

/kind support

Thanks for the issue. We have been aware of this as you could see and working with the cel-go maintainers on having Kubernetes 1.33 working with latest cel-go release. 

At the same time, as @BenTheElder mentioned above, we would suggest to stick to the default version implied by importing apiserver. Even after the PR merged, we would have 1.33 apiserver working with cel-go 0.23.x. We most likely would not backport the version bumping in K8s.

@cici37: Closing this issue.
